description:
Turn any photo into something amazing with one tap: a pro headshot, a restored old photo, a 3D figurine, an anime portrait, a royal portrait of your pet. Standard runs on Google's Nano Banana 2.1 and Max on OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5.

Your first edit starts your Pixie Week: 5 free edits a day for 7 days. No sign-up, no card, nothing to cancel.

ONE-TAP EDITS
• Pro headshot: a studio portrait for LinkedIn and CVs that still looks like you
• Headshot pack: four studio headshots in one go
• Restore old photo: scratches out, colour in
• 3D figurine: you as a collectible figure, box and all
• Natural retouch: better skin and light, no filter look
• White background: clean cutouts for listings and profiles
• Anime style, magazine cover, new outfit, new hairstyle and travel photo
• Royal pet portrait: your pet as Renaissance nobility
• Holiday card: a cosy festive portrait for your cards
• Halloween costume: a spooky costume and make-up

THEN REFINE IT BY CHAT
Ask for changes in plain words and each message edits your latest image: "make the blazer navy", "put her in a bright office". Or describe a brand-new picture from scratch.

SHARE THE BEFORE AND AFTER
Save results to Photos, or share a side-by-side before-and-after in one tap.

TWO LEVELS OF QUALITY
• Standard: fast and great for most edits, one edit per image
• Max: our most detailed model for the shots that matter, five edits per image
If one model is busy or declines a request, another takes over. A request that fails never costs you an edit.

EDITS, YOUR WAY
• PixiePocket Plus: 60 edits every week, Standard or Max. A weekly subscription that renews until you cancel it in Settings, and nothing is charged before you choose it.
• Packs of 10, 40 or 120 edits: buy once, use whenever you like, never expire.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your images are yours alone: there is no public feed. Your prompts and photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to create your images; you approve this before your first creation and can withdraw consent anytime in Settings.

Start anonymously, then sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub to keep your images in sync across iPhone and iPad.

FOR EVERYONE
Works with VoiceOver, larger text sizes and Reduce Motion. Delete your account and everything in it anytime in Settings.

promotionalText: New: a free Pixie Week of 5 edits a day, Plus with 60 edits every week, and a Holiday card edit. Standard runs Nano Banana 2.1, Max runs GPT Image 2.5.
whatsNew: Fixes the store after you start or end Plus: the button always matches the option you pick, and every tap goes through.
